newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian Dec ind. output fell 14.1, up 1.2 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Croatian Dec ind. output fell 14.1, up 1.2 pct y/y.

text.p: The Central Bureau of Statistics issued the following economic indicator details.
CROATIA INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT DEC '96 NOV '96 DEC '95

NOTES -- January-December output was put at 3.1 percent compared to the same period of 1995. Capital goods output rose 9.4 percent, production materials 3.6 and consumption goods 1.1 percent to December against a year earlier.
Data include estimates for Serb-held territory where production amounted to two percent of the total before 1991. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
